beats: 大语言模型，简称LLM，处理和生成语言。这里输入中文，按翻译要求生成英文。
A large language model, or LLM, processes and generates language. A translation request takes Chinese and returns English.
换成会议记录，模型把句子整理成事项、负责人和日期。输入材料与要求一起决定输出内容。
With meeting notes, it organizes sentences into tasks, owners and dates. The material and instructions both shape the output.
代码是给计算机执行的指令。模型先生成程序，运行后才得到排序数字。
Code gives a computer instructions. A model generates the program; running it produces the sorted numbers.
bridge: 这些是模型能参与的任务。先看屏幕上的应用、语言模型和机器各做什么。
These are tasks a model can help with. First separate the application, language model and machine.

key.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）处理和生成语言；应用把这种能力接到具体任务里。
key.en: A large language model processes and generates language; an application connects it to a task.

beats: 应用是你操作的软件：收集要求和文件，显示结果，也能调用工具。
The app collects requests and files, displays output and can call tools.
模型是生成部分：根据应用送入的文字，计算接下来写什么，再交回应用。
The model computes what to write from supplied text and returns it to the app.
模型需要在真实机器上运行。图里的芯片执行数字运算；应用、模型和机器共同完成一次回答。
A model runs on a physical machine. Chips perform numerical operations; app, model and machine together deliver a response.
bridge: 模型怎样处理文字？下一页从一个单词开始拆。
How does a model process text? Start by dividing one word.

beats: raincoat 是英语里的雨衣。分词器是把文字切成片段的程序；每个片段叫一个 Token。
Raincoat is one English word. A tokenizer is a program that divides text into pieces; each piece is a token.
示例先切出 rain。一个词可以有多个 Token，Token 不固定等于一个单词或汉字。
Our example first takes rain. A word can contain several tokens; a token is not always one word or Chinese character.
再切出 coat。词表给每个片段一个编号；编号像目录号，本身不表示这个词有多大或多重要。
Next comes coat. A vocabulary gives each piece an ID, like a catalog number; a larger ID does not mean greater importance.
模型按编号查出一串数值，再用这些数参与运算。这串数叫数值表示，也常叫向量。
The model uses the ID to look up a list of numbers for computation. This numerical representation is also called a vector.
bridge: 这些片段不仅来自最后一句问题，还来自本次一起送入的资料。
These pieces come from the material sent with the question as well as the question itself.

caption.zh: rain / coat、编号和数值为切分示意；实际切法由具体分词器决定。
caption.en: Pieces, IDs and values are illustrative; an actual tokenizer determines the split.

beats: 上下文就是这一次送给模型的全部信息。问题很短，附带的文章却可能很长；两者都要切成 Token。
Context is all the information supplied to this call. A short question can accompany a long article; both become tokens.
模型生成的摘要会接在输入后面。上下文窗口是能容纳的 Token 数量上限，要给输入和后续生成都留位置。
The generated summary follows the input. The context window is a token limit, with space needed for both input and continuation.
bridge: 现在知道了输入单位，再看模型怎样选出下一个片段。
Now use that unit to see how the next piece is selected.

lead.zh: 上下文：模型这一次收到的全部信息，包括问题、资料和选入的历史。
lead.en: Context is all information supplied to this call: the question, material and selected history.

beats: The sky is 的意思是“天空是……”。模型先读取前文，接下来要选择一个 Token。
The prefix is The sky is. The model reads it before selecting one next token.
模型参数把前文变成候选分数，再转成概率。本图预设60%、30%、10%演示抽样，并非现场测量。
Parameters turn the prefix into scores and probabilities. Preset 60/30/10 percentages isolate sampling; they are not a live measurement.
抽样像按这些比例抽签，所以不总选 blue。温度是调节概率集中程度的设置：低时更集中，高时更分散。
Sampling is a draw using those chances, so blue need not win every time. Temperature makes the distribution more concentrated when low and flatter when high.
bridge: 下一页固定选 blue 作例子，跟踪新 Token 怎样接回前文；实际抽样也可能选到别的。
Next, fix blue as the example and follow its return to the prefix; an actual draw can select another token.

caption.zh: 只画三个教学候选；概率是抽样比例，不是答案事实正确率。
caption.en: Three illustrative candidates; probability means selection chance, not factual correctness.

beats: 已有文字是 The sky is。每一步都以上一步已经有的文字为起点。
The text so far is The sky is. Each step starts with the text already available.
模型根据这段前文计算下一 Token 的概率；图中的模型重复使用，不需要每写一个词就重新训练。
The model computes next-token probabilities from the prefix. It is reused, without retraining for each new word.
这次选中 blue，意思是蓝色。它是新增的一小块，还不是整篇回答。
This draw selects blue, one new piece rather than the whole response.
把 blue 接到前文后，就得到 The sky is blue。再按同样步骤继续；这个用已有输出接着生成的过程叫自回归。
Appending blue gives The sky is blue. Repeat the same steps: generating from previous output is called autoregressive generation.
bridge: 前文中的不同信息怎样影响当前计算？下一页只看一个核心动作：按比例组合。
How does earlier information affect the current computation? Focus on one operation: combining it in proportions.

beats: 读“我买了自行车，周末下雨，想骑它”时，“它”与自行车有关。模型先把各处信息写成数值列表。
In 'I bought a bicycle; it may rain; I want to ride it', it refers to the bicycle. The model represents positions as lists of numbers.
模型比较当前位置与前文的数值表示，算出组合权重。这里给定80%和20%，只演示后面的乘加。
A model compares position representations to compute mixing weights. Preset 80/20 weights here isolate the following multiplication and addition.
每组数分别乘自己的权重，再把对应位置相加。交换权重后，哪部分影响更大也跟着变；结果继续参与生成。
Multiply each value list by its weight, then add matching entries. Swapping weights changes each contribution; the combined result feeds later computation.
bridge: 注意力比例是这次算出来的。决定怎么算的内部数值叫参数；下一页用一个数演示它怎样学出来。
Attention weights are computed for this call. Internal learned numbers called parameters determine the computation. Next, learn one parameter.

lead.zh: 注意力：让当前计算按不同比例使用前文中的信息。
lead.en: Attention lets the current computation use information from earlier positions in different proportions.

caption.zh: 自行车/天气、两维数值和 80%/20% 都是教学算例；不是实测注意力。
caption.en: Bicycle/weather labels, two-number values and 80%/20% weights are a teaching example, not measured attention.

beats: 例子是买物品：1 件付 2 元，2 件付 4 元，3 件付 6 元。参数 w 是模型暂时猜的单价；总价 = 件数 × w。
Buy 1 item for 2, 2 for 4, or 3 for 6. Parameter w is the model's current unit-price estimate; total = quantity × w.
先猜 w=0.5，得到 0.5、1、1.5 元，都低于目标。红色虚线是误差；把误差平方后取平均，得到 10.50。
With w=0.5, predictions are 0.5, 1, 1.5, all too low. Red lines show errors; averaging their squares gives mean squared error (MSE) 10.50.
三次预测都偏低，所以把单价上调。本例规则给出本轮增加0.70：0.50→1.20，平均平方误差降到2.99。
All predictions are low, so raise the price. This update rule adds 0.70: 0.50→1.20, lowering mean squared error to 2.99.
bridge: 训练就是利用例子调整内部参数。接下来分清：学参数，与拿已有参数回答新问题。
Training uses examples to adjust parameters. Separate that from answering new questions using existing parameters.

lead.zh: 参数是模型内部可调整的数。用“件数 × 单价 = 总价”看一个参数怎样学。
lead.en: A parameter is an adjustable internal number. Learn one using quantity × unit price = total.

caption.zh: w 是单价估计。平均平方误差 = 三个（预测−目标）² 的平均；本步更新幅度为演示设置。
caption.en: w estimates unit price. MSE averages the three squared prediction errors; the update size is chosen for this example.

beats: 训练用许多已知输入和目标的例子，反复预测、比较、调参数。学好的参数保存成一个模型版本。
Training repeatedly predicts, compares and adjusts using examples with known targets. Learned parameters are saved as a model version.
推理就是使用这个版本处理新输入。贴一份新文件后能回答，是因为这次读到了文件，通常没有因此改变参数。
Inference uses that version on new input. A supplied document can inform a response because it is in context, usually without changing parameters.
bridge: 同样的区别也适用于语言模型：先学会续写，再学习怎样更好地回答任务，最后用于调用。
Language models also learn continuation, learn task responses, then serve calls.

lead.zh: 训练：调整参数。推理：用训练好的参数处理这一次输入。
lead.en: Training adjusts parameters. Inference uses learned parameters on this input.

caption.zh: 微调指在已有模型上继续训练；贴入文件是提供上下文。
caption.en: Fine-tuning continues training from an existing model; supplying a document provides context.

beats: 语言训练的目标是文本里真实的下一Token。例如目标blue，比较模型给它的概率，再更新参数；不是对Token编号做价格式回归。
Language training evaluates the actual next token, such as target blue, and updates from its predicted probability; token IDs are not price-regression targets.
任务说明、材料与好回答可组成训练序列。后训练用这些示范或反馈继续调整，塑造按指令回答的行为。
Instructions, material and good responses can form training sequences. Post-training uses demonstrations or feedback to shape instruction following.
推理时计算是一次任务中花的计算量。可以生成更长的中间步骤，或多试几份候选再比较；这通常不更新参数。
Inference compute is work spent on one task. Generate intermediate steps or compare several candidates; this usually does not update parameters.
bridge: 下面固定模型版本，只改变给它的任务说明，看看输出目标怎样变清楚。
Keep the model version fixed and change the instructions to make the desired output clearer.

beats: 给模型的任务说明叫提示词，英文 Prompt。“整理一下”没有说明要摘要、改写还是待办，仍有很多选择。
A prompt gives instructions to a model. 'Organize this' leaves open a summary, rewrite or task list.
改成“提取事项、负责人、日期，用表格呈现”，就明确了做什么和输出形式。反复改这些说明，就是提示词工程。
'Extract task, owner and date into a table' specifies the operation and format. Improving these instructions is prompt engineering.
bridge: 要求说清后，还要看原文有没有这些信息。下一页逐项对应。
Clear instructions still depend on available information. Match the source to the result next.

lead.zh: 提示词（Prompt）是给模型的任务说明。用同一份会议记录比较两种问法。
lead.en: A prompt gives the model instructions. Compare two requests about the same meeting notes.

beats: “小李周四交初稿”分别提供事项、负责人、日期。
One source sentence supplies a task, owner and date.
放到对应三列；评审负责人没说，就写“未提及”。
Place them in the three columns; keep the unspecified review owner absent.
bridge: 字段来自材料。下一页看材料怎样送入调用。
Fields need source material. Next assemble that material into a call.

beats: 一次调用是把输入送给模型再接收结果。先放入要做什么的任务说明。
A call sends input and receives a result. First supply the task instructions.
再选入相关对话；界面里保存的历史未必都发送。
Select relevant conversation; stored history need not all be sent.
应用读出文件或工具结果，实际放入这次输入。
The app reads files or tool results and actually supplies their content.
这些信息组装为一次输入；选择和组织它们就是上下文工程。
Assemble the input: selecting and organizing its information is context engineering.
bridge: 资料太多时，先找相关段落，再组装输入；这就是下一页的检索步骤。
When there is too much material, retrieve relevant passages before assembling the input.

beats: 用户问报销最晚什么时候交。系统先用这个问题查公司制度；检索就是从资料中找相关内容。
The user asks for an expense deadline. The system first searches company policy; retrieval finds relevant source material.
检索找到“次月 5 日前提交”这一段。现在得到的是原文片段，还没有生成给用户的回答。
Retrieval finds 'submit by the fifth of next month'. This is a source passage, not yet the generated user response.
应用把问题和找到的片段一起送给模型；模型本次因此读到了这条制度。
The app supplies the question and passage together, making this policy available to the model for the call.
模型根据片段组织答案。RAG 是检索增强生成的缩写：先找资料，再带着资料生成。
The model answers using the passage. RAG means retrieval-augmented generation: retrieve material, then generate with it.
bridge: 检索由软件执行。接下来把“模型提出动作”和“程序实际执行”拆开。
Software performs retrieval. Next separate a model proposing an action from software executing it.

lead.zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）：先从外部资料找相关片段，再一起送给模型。
lead.en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) supplies relevant external passages with the question.

title.zh: RAG：先找资料，再带着资料回答

beats: 应用先提供可用工具说明，例如天气工具需要城市和日期。模型才知道怎样提出请求。
The app describes available tools, including weather's city and day inputs, so the model can request a call.
模型生成工具名称和所需信息。代码中的 city 是城市、day 是日期；这些叫调用参数，还不是查到的结果。
The model produces a tool name and inputs. In the code city and day specify the request; these arguments are not the weather result.
外围程序读懂这个请求，实际调用天气服务。发起网络查询的是程序，不是屏幕上的文字自己在执行。
The surrounding program reads the request and calls the weather service. Software performs the query described by the generated text.
服务返回 rain，意思是下雨。程序把结果再送入模型，模型才可以据此继续安排。
The service returns rain. The program supplies that result to the model, which can then continue planning.
bridge: 把准备输入、执行工具和保留结果的外围程序连起来，叫 Harness。下一页看它怎样支持 Agent 循环。
The surrounding program that prepares inputs, executes tools and retains results is a harness. Next, use it for an agent loop.

lead.zh: 工具调用：模型写出想执行的动作，外围程序执行，再把结果送回来。
lead.en: Tool calling: a model describes an action, software executes it, and the result returns.

beats: 目标是安排杭州周六半日活动。Agent（智能体）在这里指：模型根据当前信息提出下一步动作，程序执行后再继续。
The goal is a Saturday half-day plan in Hangzhou. Here an agent uses a model to propose actions from current information, then continues after software executes them.
Harness 是围绕模型运行的程序。它先查天气，把“下雨”这条新结果放进下一次输入。
The harness is the program around the model. It obtains weather and includes the new rain result in the next input.
模型根据天气提议下一工具：雨天查场馆，晴天查公园。示意分支用于追踪信息流；仅有分支不能判定Agent。
A model proposes a tool from weather observations. These illustrative paths expose information flow; branching alone does not establish an agent.
程序接着查场馆时间或公园路线，再把结果送回。Harness/Agent 工程就是把输入、动作、结果和下一轮组织成可工作的软件。
Software checks opening hours or a park route and returns the result. Harness/agent engineering connects inputs, actions, results and subsequent calls.
bridge: 有的任务顺序可以提前写好，有的要读结果再选。下一页对比这两种安排。
Some task sequences can be predefined; others choose after reading results. Compare both.

lead.zh: Agent（智能体）读当前结果再选下一步；Harness 是执行并串联这些步骤的外围程序。
lead.en: An agent chooses the next action from results; a harness executes and connects those steps.

beats: 工作流的路径由程序预先写好，也可以有if/else分支；这里按转录、摘要的顺序运行。
Workflow paths are predefined in code and can include if/else branches; this example transcribes then summarizes.
Agent 则让模型读到结果后再提出动作：缺来源就搜索，缺数值就计算。两种方式可以在同一个应用里组合。
An agent lets the model propose actions after reading results: search for sources or calculate missing numbers. An app can combine both approaches.
bridge: 下一步可能要改刚才的结果。先用三个价格，看看反馈到底改了什么。
The next action may revise a result. Use three prices to see what feedback actually changes.

beats: 目标是把价格 20、100、3 从小到大排。JavaScript 默认按文字顺序比，先比开头的 1、2、3，所以得到 100、20、3。
The goal is to sort prices 20, 100, 3 numerically. JavaScript's default text order compares leading 1, 2, 3, giving 100, 20, 3.
把输出交回模型后，加上“按数值比较”的规则，再运行得到 3、20、100。不必会读这行代码：看目标、运行结果和修改的对应。
Feed back the output, add a numeric comparison rule and run again to get 3, 20, 100. Focus on the goal, result and revision; reading the syntax is optional.
bridge: 这次改的是排序程序。下一页把改结果、改助手和改模型放在一起比较。
The sorting program changed. Compare that with changing the assistant or model.

lead.zh: 反馈是把运行结果带回下一轮。例子：三个价格没有按数值排好，读结果后修改。
lead.en: Feedback carries execution results into the next attempt. Here, read a wrong price order and revise it.

beats: 改排序代码：当前成果变，模型可以不变。
Revise sorting code: change the artifact, not necessarily the model.
给助手加运行工具：以后的工作方式变。
Add an execution tool: change future assistant behavior.
训练更新参数：模型版本变。循环工程先决定反馈送回哪个对象。
Training changes model parameters. Loop engineering locates the object receiving feedback.
bridge: 下一页看新能力如何用于继续改进自身。
Next feed improved capability into improving the system again.

lead.zh: 先问“哪个东西变了”：当前结果、外围助手程序，还是模型内部参数？
lead.en: Ask what changed: this result, the surrounding assistant program, or the model's internal parameters?

beats: RSI即递归自我改进。假设助手先提出给自己的搜索工具加批量查询。
RSI means recursive self-improvement. Suppose an assistant proposes batch search for its own tools.
实现后，新工具帮助收集下一轮改进方法所需资料。
The implemented tool gathers material for the next method improvement.
新版本用改过的方法继续研究怎样改自己。
The new version uses that method to investigate further changes to itself.
回箭头指向改进机制。版本号不代表效果，仍要看同题结果怎样变化。
Feedback returns to the improvement mechanism; same-task outcomes, not version labels, establish gains.
bridge: 一个助手可以多轮工作；也可以把独立问题交给几个助手同时做。
One assistant can work over several rounds; several assistants can tackle independent questions together.

beats: 协调者把三个产品分开调查，都问容量、价格、续航。
The coordinator assigns three product investigations with the same capacity, price and battery questions.
工作者各有上下文，同一模型可以分别调用三次；不要求三种模型。
Workers have separate contexts; one model can serve three calls without requiring three different models.
摘要交回后才能合成总表。Agent swarm常指这样一组协作智能体。
Returned summaries enable synthesis; agent swarm often describes such a collaborating group.
bridge: 能独立展开的任务可以同时开始。下一页算的是用户实际等了多久。
Independent tasks can start together. Next calculate how long the user actually waits.

lead.zh: 多智能体：几个独立助手分工，通过传递任务和结果共同完成工作。
lead.en: Multi-agent systems divide work among independent assistants and exchange tasks and results.

caption.zh: 虚构手机比较：GB 表示存储容量，h 表示小时；多个工作者可使用同一个模型。
caption.en: Fictional phone comparison: GB is storage capacity, h is hours; workers can share the same model.

beats: Serial: 4+4+4+2=14 minutes.
资源允许时同时做：等4分钟再汇总2分钟，共6分钟；工作量仍为14分钟。
With sufficient resources, parallel tasks take four minutes plus two for synthesis; effort remains fourteen worker-minutes.
bridge: 休息10分钟。回来讲承载这些运算的机器。
Take ten minutes. Resume with the machines executing this work.

beats: GPU 是擅长大量相似运算的处理器。显存是它旁边用来存数字的空间，放模型参数和运行数据；容量常用 GB 表示。
A GPU is a processor suited to many similar operations. Device memory holds parameters and working data; capacity is commonly measured in GB.
计算单元要先拿到数字。带宽是每秒能搬多少数据，常用 GB/s；空间大与搬得快是两个指标。
Compute units must receive the numbers. Bandwidth measures data moved per second, often GB/s; capacity and movement rate are different.
输入[2,3]、[1,4]都与参数[5,4]逐项相乘相加，独立得到22、21。GPU并行做许多这类计算。
Inputs [2,3] and [1,4] use shared parameters [5,4] to produce independent sums 22 and 21; GPUs parallelize many such operations.
bridge: 模型参数都要占空间。下一页先把数字单位说清，再计算 80 亿参数的体积。
Parameters take storage. Define the units, then calculate the size of eight billion parameters.

lead.zh: GPU 是一种处理器，擅长同时做大量相似计算；运行模型还需要显存和数据搬运。
lead.en: A GPU is a processor suited to many similar calculations at once; memory and data movement also matter.

beats: 参数也叫权重。1 字节 = 8 bit；bit 是一个二进制位。FP16 用 16 bit 存一个数，即 2 字节，80 亿个数约占 16 GB。
Parameters are also called weights. A byte has eight bits; a bit is a binary digit. FP16 uses 16 bits, or two bytes per value: eight billion values take about 16 GB.
量化是用更少的位表示数值。若平均每个数用 4 bit，名义体积变为 4 GB；表示更紧凑，也会改变数值精度。
Quantization represents values with fewer bits. At an average four bits per value, nominal size is 4 GB; compactness changes numerical precision.
运行时还要存刚才计算的中间结果和前文记录。缓存就是留住结果供后面复用；下一页看这部分怎样随生成增长。
Runtime also stores intermediate results and earlier context states. A cache retains results for reuse; next see it grow during generation.
bridge: 模型放进机器后，需要程序安排在哪台运行、怎样执行。下一页分别看这两件事。
Once stored, software must place and execute the model. Separate those two jobs next.

lead.zh: 权重就是模型参数。先认识 bit、字节和 GB，再算存这些数需要多少空间。
lead.en: Weights are model parameters. Define bits, bytes and GB before calculating their storage size.

key.zh: 位数越少，原始权重体积越小；运行还需要缓存和临时数据。
key.en: Fewer bits reduce raw weight size; runtime also needs caches and temporary data.

caption.zh: 1 字节 = 8 bit；十进制 1 GB = 10 亿字节。只计算原始权重，4 bit 格式另有附加数据。
caption.en: One byte = eight bits; decimal GB = one billion bytes. Raw weights only; four-bit formats also have extra metadata.

beats: 集群是联网管理的一组机器；其中一台叫节点。Kubernetes，简称 K8s，是安排程序在哪台机器运行的软件。
A cluster is a managed group of networked machines; each machine is a node. Kubernetes, or K8s, places programs on those machines.
这里要一块 GPU，第一台有空位，就把一个模型服务放过去。实例就是正在运行的一份服务；Pod 是 K8s 放置它的运行单元。
This service needs one GPU and node one has room. An instance is one running copy of a service; a pod is its Kubernetes execution unit.
推理引擎是在节点上加载参数、执行模型计算的程序，例如 vLLM。K8s 管放哪里，引擎管怎样算。
An inference engine loads parameters and runs model computation on a node, for example vLLM. K8s places the service; the engine executes it.
Prefill处理A/B/C生成D并保存旧记录。Decode读取A/B/C缓存，计算并追加D的记录，再生成E；没有丢掉前文。
Prefill processes A/B/C, caches their states and generates D. Decode reads those states, computes and appends D's states, then generates E.
bridge: 一份模型可以跨设备合作，也可以完整复制多份。下一页看为什么要区分。
One model can span cooperating devices, or be copied into independent instances. Compare them.

lead.zh: 集群是一组联网的机器。Kubernetes（K8s）安排服务放哪里，推理引擎负责运行模型。
lead.en: A cluster is a group of networked machines. Kubernetes (K8s) places services; an inference engine runs the model.

caption.zh: Prefill = 先处理输入；Decode = 逐步生成。KV 缓存保存注意力中的键/值数值，供后续复用。
caption.en: Prefill processes input; decode generates step by step. A KV cache retains attention key/value states for reuse.

beats: 左边一个模型分在两块 GPU 上合作。它们为同一份模型交换数据；例如一块显存放不下时，可以分开存和算。
On the left, two GPUs cooperate on one model and exchange data. Splitting storage and computation can help when one device cannot fit it.
右边每块 GPU 都有完整的一份模型，叫副本。请求 A 和 B 各去一份，可以同时服务两个用户；也可以复制多组跨卡模型。
On the right, each GPU has a complete replica. Requests A and B go to separate copies, serving users concurrently. A multi-GPU model can also be replicated.
bridge: 更多设备改变处理能力。用户的等待时间和系统总处理量，要分开量。
More devices change capacity. Measure user waiting time separately from total system output.

beats: 延迟就是一次请求要等多久。从点击发送开始计时，直到回答全部结束，是端到端延迟。
Latency measures how long a request takes. End-to-end latency runs from sending it to the completed response.
0.8 秒时第一个 Token 到达。首 Token 等待时间简称 TTFT，包括网络、排队和处理输入等时间。
The first token arrives at 0.8 seconds. Time to first token, TTFT, includes network, queueing and input processing.
第一个之后还生成 2 秒，文字逐步到达。这段是后续生成时间，和首个之前的等待分开看。
More tokens arrive over the next two seconds. This is subsequent generation time, separate from the wait for the first token.
在 2.8 秒回答结束。首个等待 0.8 秒 + 后续生成 2 秒 = 全程 2.8 秒。
The response ends at 2.8 seconds: 0.8 seconds to the first token plus two seconds of further generation.
bridge: 接下来把同一条时间线放大，算相邻 Token 到达的间隔。
Zoom into this same timeline to calculate intervals between token arrivals.

lead.zh: 延迟是一次请求花的时间；分别看多久开始有字、多久全部结束。
lead.en: Latency is time for a request: distinguish the first visible output from full completion.

beats: 先看 3 个到达点只有 2 个间隔。因此 101 个 Token 有 100 个间隔；20 毫秒是 0.020 秒，合起来 2 秒。
Three arrivals have only two gaps. So 101 tokens have 100 gaps; 20 milliseconds is 0.020 seconds, totaling two seconds.
只看首个之后：100÷2=50 Token/秒。算全程则要带上前面等的 0.8 秒：101÷2.8≈36 Token/秒。计时范围不同，数字就不同。
After the first: 100÷2=50 tokens/s. Over the whole request: 101÷2.8≈36 tokens/s, including the initial 0.8-second wait. The time ranges differ.
bridge: 这只是一名用户的回答。下一页把多名用户的输出一起统计。
That was one user's response. Next count output across users.

lead.zh: 毫秒（ms）是千分之一秒。先数间隔，再用 Token 数除以对应时间。
lead.en: A millisecond (ms) is one thousandth of a second. Count gaps, then divide token count by the matching time.

caption.zh: 平均相邻 Token 间隔叫 ITL；此处不含第一个 Token 到来前的等待。
caption.en: Average inter-token latency, ITL, excludes the wait before the first token.

beats: 吞吐是系统每秒一共处理多少，这里数输出 Token。四人分别要 2、4、1、3 个，共 10 个；两个槽位表示每轮最多推进两人。
Throughput measures total work per second, here output tokens. Four requests need 2, 4, 1, 3 tokens, ten in total. Two slots advance at most two requests per round.
每格 A1 表示 A 的第一个 Token。第 3 轮 A 已结束：固定批次空等 B，连续批处理把 C 放进空位；下方一轮一轮比较。
Cell A1 is A's first token. By round three A has finished: fixed batches wait for B, while continuous batching puts C in the free slot. Compare round by round.
同样10个Token，固定批次7轮、连续批处理6轮。B两种都第4轮完成：总吞吐提高不等于每个人都更快。
Ten tokens finish in seven versus six rounds, but B finishes at round four under both: aggregate throughput and individual latency differ.
bridge: 让这套计算持续服务很多人，还要把电力、散热和网络一起组织起来。
Serving many people continuously also requires organized power, cooling and networking.

lead.zh: 吞吐量是系统每秒完成的总工作量；批处理是把多个请求放在一起计算。
lead.en: Throughput is total work completed per second; batching groups requests for computation.

caption.zh: 简化算例：只看逐步生成，每槽位每轮 1 Token；忽略输入处理与调度开销，不代表真实每轮速度。
caption.en: Simplified decode-only example: one token per slot per round, ignoring input processing and scheduling cost; not measured speed.

beats: 芯片耗电发热，机房提供电力、散热与网络。
Chips consume power and release heat; facilities supply power, cooling and networking.
机架装机器，机器里有处理器与内存；联网组织成集群。
Racks hold machines with processors and memory, connected as a cluster.
引擎加载参数运行，模型服务接收请求、生成结果。
Engines load parameters and execute; model services receive requests and return results.
“Token工厂”比喻这套持续运行的系统，不是一种新模型。
A token factory is a metaphor for this continuously operating system, not a new model.
bridge: 下一页跟踪手机的一句话，把机房和屏幕连起来。
Follow one phone request to connect the datacenter with the screen.

beats: 手机上运行的是应用。它把当前问题和选入的资料打包，通过网络发送给模型服务。
The phone runs the app. It packages the question and selected material and sends them to a model service.
模型服务收到请求，使用训练好的模型版本。服务通常在远端机器运行，不要求手机装下整份模型。
The service receives the request and uses a trained model version, often on a remote machine rather than on the phone.
推理引擎在 GPU 上读取参数和缓存，执行数字运算。这里是计算发生的位置，不是又多了一层语言模型。
The inference engine reads parameters and cache and computes on the GPU. This is where execution occurs, rather than another language model.
生成的 Token 经网络逐步返回，手机显示文字。去程送问题，回程送结果，才完成一次远程调用。
Generated tokens return over the network and the phone displays text. Sending the input and receiving the result completes the remote call.
bridge: 基础设施路径已经连上。下面看这些调用在具体工作里形成什么结果。
The infrastructure path is connected. Now see what these calls produce in real tasks.

beats: 人用文字说清数值升序的目标。
A person states the numeric ordering goal.
模型生成比较规则，程序运行得到3、20、100。生成和执行各做一步。
The model generates a numeric comparator; execution returns 3, 20, 100.
bridge: 下一页把文件、修改、运行接成往返。
Next connect files, edits and execution into a round trip.

beats: 编辑器是改文件的软件，终端是运行命令的入口。助手先选入需求和相关文件，模型才知道这次改什么。
An editor changes files; a terminal runs commands. The assistant supplies the request and relevant files so the model knows what to change.
模型生成修改建议，编辑工具把建议写进文件。提出修改与实际写文件，是两个不同动作。
The model proposes an edit; an editing tool writes it to the file. Proposing and applying a change are different actions.
终端运行程序，把正常输出或报错返回。这个可观察结果被放进模型下一次输入。
The terminal runs the program and returns output or an error. That observation enters the model's next input.
模型根据结果再改，再运行。读文件提供上下文，工具执行动作，返回结果接起任务循环。
The model revises based on results and runs again. Files supply context, tools act, and returned observations connect the task loop.
bridge: 代码是文字形式的指令。图像生成则可以从随机数字开始，一轮轮改变状态。
Code is instructions in text. Image generation can instead start with random numbers and iteratively change a state.

beats: 噪声是随机数形成的杂点，不是藏着一张照片。文字条件说明要画什么，例如绿色遮阳篷的咖啡店。
Noise is a pattern of random numbers, not a hidden photograph. The text condition describes the requested café with a green awning.
训练时用加噪图像学习预测噪声或更新。生成时模型读当前状态、文字与步数，给出本轮更新；这里示意为−0.20。
Training uses noisy images to learn noise or updates. During generation the model reads state, text and timestep; −0.20 illustrates one update.
按更新改变当前状态，再送回同一个模型。逐轮得到更符合条件的状态；回箭头表示继续改这份状态。
Apply the update and feed the new state to the same model. Iteration moves it toward the condition; the return arrow carries the updated state.
在这类潜空间扩散中，状态是压缩的数值表示。解码器把最终表示转为能显示的像素，才得到画面。
In this latent-diffusion example, states are compressed numerical representations. A decoder converts the final representation into visible pixels.
bridge: 一张图之外，还可以把文案、画面和声音接成一个短片工作流。
Beyond one image, connect script, visuals and audio into a short-film workflow.

lead.zh: 扩散模型的一种生成方式：从随机噪声开始，按文字条件反复调整数值，再得到图像。
lead.en: One diffusion workflow starts with random noise, repeatedly updates values using text conditions, then produces an image.

caption.zh: 潜空间扩散的过程示意；中间状态不是模型实测结果，解码后才是可显示图像。
caption.en: Latent-diffusion process illustration; intermediate states are not measured model output, and decoding produces the visible image.

beats: AIGC 是 AI 生成内容的缩写。先写 15 秒短片的场景、镜头和旁白，给后面各步明确材料。
AIGC means AI-generated content. A 15-second script specifies scenes, shots and narration for subsequent steps.
画面按 0、5、10 秒排列。视频是连续的图像序列，镜头推进时，要保持咖啡店与前后画面相连。
Visuals are ordered at 0, 5 and 10 seconds. Video is an image sequence, with café identity and motion kept continuous.
声音用时间上的波形表示。把旁白放在合适的位置、调整长度，让声音和画面对齐。
A waveform represents audio over time. Place and trim narration so its timing aligns with the visuals.
剪辑把各片段排进同一条时间线，再导出完整短片。多模态指处理文字、图像或声音等不同形式的信息。
Editing arranges clips on one timeline and exports a film. Multimodal means handling forms such as text, images and audio.
bridge: 生成内容之外，AI 也预测科学对象。先用一串字母和一个空间形状理解蛋白质任务。
AI also predicts scientific objects. Use a letter sequence and a spatial shape to understand a protein task.

lead.zh: AIGC 指 AI 生成内容。以 15 秒咖啡店短片为例，看文字、画面与声音怎样接力。
lead.en: AIGC means AI-generated content. Follow text, visuals and audio through a 15-second café film.

beats: 蛋白质由氨基酸连成链。每个字母代表一种氨基酸，顺序不同就像材料排列不同；这里显示其中一小段。
A protein is a chain of amino acids. Letters identify amino-acid types in order; only a short segment is shown.
AlphaFold 是预测蛋白质结构的模型系统。它利用学习到的规律和相关输入，预测这条链在空间中怎样排列。
AlphaFold is a model system for protein-structure prediction. It uses learned patterns and related inputs to predict the chain's spatial arrangement.
右边示意同一条链在三维中的形状。AI4S 是 AI for Science，即 AI 用于科学研究；这里的输出是结构预测。
The right illustrates the chain's three-dimensional shape. AI4S means AI for Science; the output here is a predicted structure.
bridge: 研究还要比较候选、继续计算或实验。下一页把预测和新观察分开看。
Research also compares candidates and performs calculations or experiments. Separate predictions from new observations next.

lead.zh: 蛋白质是一条氨基酸链；这个任务根据链的序列，预测它在三维空间中的结构。
lead.en: A protein is an amino-acid chain; this task predicts a three-dimensional structure from its sequence.

beats: 假设寻找更耐热的材料。横轴是成分比例，纵轴是耐热指标，越高越好；蓝点是模型对 A 到 J 的预测。
Imagine searching for heat-resistant material. The x-axis is composition, the y-axis a heat-resistance score, higher is better. Blue points predict candidates A to J.
F、G 的预测较高，所以先选它们做后续研究。筛选是在决定下一批查谁，还没有证明实际性质。
F and G have high predictions, so investigate them first. Selection decides what to examine next; it does not establish their actual properties.
进一步计算或实验得到新观察：F 是 0.58，G 是 0.76。表格把预测值和观察值放在不同列。
Further calculation or experiment gives new observations: F is 0.58, G 0.76. Predictions and observations occupy separate columns.
把新观察放回图，先更新下一轮研究依据。可以用于再训练，但收到反馈本身不等于参数已改变。
Return observations to inform the next research choice. They may support retraining, but receiving feedback alone does not change parameters.
bridge: 科学任务把预测接回研究。普通工作也会把不同模型与软件动作串起来。
Scientific tasks connect predictions to research; everyday work also connects models with software actions.

lead.zh: 例子：在许多材料配方中，先用模型挑出值得进一步计算或实验的候选。
lead.en: Use model predictions to choose promising material recipes for further calculation or experiment.

caption.zh: 配方与耐热分数为虚构的 0–1 教学数据；蓝色为预测，绿色为新观察。
caption.en: Recipes and heat-resistance scores are fictional 0–1 teaching data; blue means predicted, green means newly observed.

beats: 录音波形表示声音，还没有文字。
The recording contains sound, not yet text.
语音识别把声音转成三句原文。
Speech recognition produces the three source sentences.
语言模型提取三列；没提供的负责人留缺失。
A language model extracts three fields, keeping missing owners absent.
普通软件再写入任务系统；相对日期须结合会议日期解释，才能定位到日历。
Software writes tasks; relative dates need a meeting-date reference before calendar placement.
bridge: 刚才是识别、生成和软件动作的组合。接下来对比 AI 的其他输出形式。
That combined recognition, generation and software actions. Compare other forms of AI output.

beats: 分类：图片输入，输出“猫”这个类别。
Classification maps the image to the category cat.
预测：横轴时间、纵轴需求，历史实线延伸到未来估计虚线。
Forecasting extends demand history into an estimated future value; time runs horizontally.
感知给位置和障碍，规划选绕行路线，输出动作顺序。
Perception supplies positions and obstacles; planning supplies a route and action sequence.
bridge: 同样叫 AI，任务和输出可以不同。最后看谁提供这些能力，以及应用怎样接入。
AI tasks can have very different outputs. Finish with industry roles and ways to connect an app.

beats: 硬件与设施提供芯片、网络、电力和散热。
Hardware and facilities supply chips, networks, power and cooling.
模型团队训练参数；服务团队把模型运营成可调用的服务。
Model teams train parameters; serving teams operate callable models.
API是程序调用程序的接口，工具把能力接到应用。
APIs connect programs; tools connect capabilities to apps.
应用把能力接到具体工作；同一家公司可以跨多层。
Applications connect capabilities to work; one company can span roles.
bridge: 已有 API 服务可以直接调用，也可以拿到模型参数自己运行。下一页比较这两条路径。
Call an existing API service, or obtain parameters and run a model yourself. Compare those paths next.

lead.zh: 沿着机器、模型、运行工具和应用，看产业中的不同工作角色。
lead.en: Follow machines, models, operating tools and applications to identify industry roles.

beats: 调用API：应用发请求，服务方运行模型并返回结果。
An API call sends a request to a provider-operated model and returns output.
自行运行：准备权重、引擎和机器，再调用自己的服务。开放权重与完整开源涉及的发布内容和许可不同。
Self-hosting supplies weights, an engine and machines. Open weights and full open-source release concern different contents and licensing.
bridge: 我们的平台主要帮助组织右边的模型服务和机器资源。把它放回整张图。
Our platform mainly organizes model services and compute resources on the right. Place it in the map.

lead.zh: API 是程序之间的调用接口。同一个应用，可以调用别人运行的模型，也可以调用自己的服务。
lead.en: An API connects programs. The same app can call a provider-operated model or your own service.

beats: 应用和Harness组织任务、资料与工具。
The app and harness organize tasks, context and tools.
LunaNexa组织模型访问、服务与计算资源。
LunaNexa organizes model access, services and compute.
K8s安排运行位置，引擎在设备上执行。
Kubernetes places services; engines execute on devices.
bridge: 最后沿完整请求回收这些分工。
Finish by reconnecting the complete request.

beats: 用户给会议原文，要求整理成事项表。
The user supplies notes and requests a task table.
应用准备提示词和资料，Harness发送调用。
The app prepares instructions and context; the harness sends the call.
模型用学到的参数逐Token生成表格。
The model uses learned parameters to generate the table token by token.
虚线表示引擎和芯片执行这份模型运算。
The dashed link means engines and chips execute that same computation.
结果返回应用，再显示或执行工具。需要继续时，结果进入下一轮。
Output returns to the app for display or tools, feeding another round if needed.
bridge: 最后五分钟围绕这张图提问：输入是什么、谁执行、输出给谁？可以回到对应的演示。
Use the final five minutes for questions: what enters, who executes, and who receives the output? Revisit the relevant diagram.

lead.zh: 用同一个会议任务串起来：准备输入、运行模型、返回结果，再接到工作中。
lead.en: Connect one meeting task: prepare input, execute the model, return output and continue the work.
